quick: All FDA label sections are shown verbatim below
indications: For the relief of the symptoms of dandruff.

label.Indications and usage: For the relief of the symptoms of dandruff.
label.Dosage and administration: Apply a small amount quantity of the product into hair and massage the scalp. Rinse thoroughly with enough water, repeat if needed. For best results, use at least twice a week or as directed by a doctor.
label.Warnings: For external use only. Do not use on wounds or damaged skin or on a child under 12 years of age unless directed by a physician.
